topics.name: OpenAI GPT-5 Model Router
topics.summary: GPT-5 is framed not as a bigger pre-training model but as an intelligent router allocating compute based on query monetizability. High-value queries like 'DUI lawyer near me' trigger expensive reasoning models with many tool calls; trivial queries get cheap fast responses. Enables variable-cost agentic commerce.

topics.name: ChatGPT Advertising and Agentic Commerce
topics.summary: Semi-Analysis argues ChatGPT will replace Google's ad revenue through agentic checkout commissions rather than display ads. Fiji Simo's hire as CEO of Applications signals intent; Sam Altman's tone on ads has softened. Commerce partners include Stripe, Visa, PayPal, Shopify, Booking.com, Instacart, and Mercari.

topics.name: Google vs. OpenAI Strategic Debate
topics.summary: Debated from bull and bear perspectives. Bear: ChatGPT growing 135% YoY threatens search ad revenue; marginal costs now exist for AI unlike zero-cost Google search. Bull: Google has DeepMind, TPUs, GCP momentum, and a research culture Ben Thompson argues enables paradigm survival.

topics.name: METIS AI Researcher Rankings v2
topics.summary: Updated ranking of top 128 AI researchers. Noam Shazeer #1, Ilya Sutskever #2, Demis Hassabis added at #3, Dario Amodei #4, John Shulman #5. Jan LeCun dropped off entirely. By lab: OpenAI 24, DeepMind 23, Anthropic 22, Thinking Machines 12, Meta 8. By country: USA 51, China 14, UK 13, Canada 12.

topics.name: Open Door Real Estate Tech Revival
topics.summary: Keith Rabois argues Open Door could be a $50-100B company with a new AI-native CEO, GNA cuts to potentially 100 employees via AI, and a pivot away from legacy broker partnerships. Current management has failed to capitalize on its disruptive potential during a three-year window.

topics.name: NVIDIA H20 Chip Exports to China
topics.summary: Trump approved H20 GPU exports to China with approximately 15% revenue share to the U.S. government. China's regulators urged Alibaba, ByteDance, and others to avoid H20s and justify orders. Constitutional questions raised about an export tax on chips not manufactured in the U.S.

topics.name: AI Psychosis and Mental Health
topics.summary: UCSF psychiatrist Keith Sakata documented 12 hospitalizations this year linked to AI model interactions exacerbating existing vulnerabilities like sleep loss or substance use. AI does not cause psychosis but softens reality's pushback and creates reinforcing feedback loops. Recommended human-in-the-loop safety and pro-social AI design.

topics.name: Early-Stage Venture Capital in the AI Era
topics.summary: Alfred Lin from Sequoia discussed the ARC company-building program, founder-driven transformation, AI enabling fewer employees per startup, and the importance of stealth before launch to avoid inviting competition.

topics.name: AI Supernova vs. Shooting Star Companies
topics.summary: Bessemer's State of AI report shows top AI companies reaching $100M ARR in 1.5 years vs 6-7 years for prior cloud companies. Many have negative gross margins as compute demand grows faster than model efficiency improvements. Revenue durability and gross margin trajectory are key underwriting questions.

topics.name: Browser Wars and Agentic AI Interface
topics.summary: Bessemer predicts browsers will be the dominant agentic AI interface. Perplexity's Comet praised for replacing Chrome via full-context AI across all web activity. OpenAI expected to launch a browser. Owning the browser context may be necessary to deliver truly personalized AI.

topics.name: Federal Reserve Interest Rate Policy and AI Growth
topics.summary: Keith Rabois called for replacing Fed Chair Powell, arguing rates are too high and that AI-driven productivity can enable consistent 3%+ GDP growth without inflation, similar to 1950-2010 patterns. Upstart's data shows consumer stress with defaults at post-COVID highs and personal savings at historic lows.

topics.name: AI in Consumer Gaming and Entertainment
topics.summary: InWorld raised $120M and launched an AI runtime enabling conversational NPCs and generative on-the-fly content for Xbox, Disney, and Niantic. Addresses the core problem of content creation velocity failing to keep pace with user consumption speed.

topics.name: AI-Powered Cybersecurity
topics.summary: Method Security is building offensive and defensive AI tools for DOD and commercial clients. AI is enabling known attack techniques at unprecedented scale; one billion dollars earmarked for offensive cyber operations in the Big Beautiful Bill.

topics.name: Consumer Financial Health
topics.summary: Upstart's macro index shows consumer credit defaults at highest levels since pre-COVID across all loan categories; personal savings rate at near-historic lows. Triple-digit Upstart revenue growth signals AI lending is working but the underlying consumer is stressed.

topics.name: AI-Native Social Media
topics.summary: Talia Goldberg excited about a new social platform built on AI-native thinking, suggesting bots could solve the chicken-and-egg problem. Character.ai cited as a missed opportunity. Zach's ShareAura takes a human-first approach, using AI only for creative backgrounds while keeping human activity at the core.

topics.name: AI and Post-Literacy
topics.summary: Nick Carter's viral post warned kids raised in the AI era may become post-literate, relying on AI to auto-complete thoughts. Hosts argued AI is better for knowledge retrieval than communication drafting, and that using ChatGPT to write emails atrophies thinking.

topics.name: Igor Babushkin Departs xAI to Launch VC Firm
topics.summary: Breaking news: xAI co-founder and METIS #24 researcher Igor Babushkin is departing to start a venture firm supporting AI safety research and backing agentic systems startups.
